intro.label: DATA BEATS TASTE
intro.subcopy: We are not decorators. We are your revenue partners.
intro.body: In the same building, one unit earns triple another. Same location. Same size. The difference is the setup, and the setup is a choice. Most owners leave that to taste and guesswork. OBÉ treats it as what it is, a performance decision, made once and made right, from data instead of opinion.

items.title: Lower Nightly Rates
